name: Ozapay
description:
Ozapay (OZA) is a utility and rewards token built on the Solana blockchain using the Token-2022 standard. It is part of Ozapay, a French-developed payment Super App combining a self-custodial cryptocurrency wallet, digital asset transactions, local business discovery, merchant offers, and loyalty rewards.

OZA supports a unified rewards ecosystem designed to connect users and participating merchants. The token is intended for use in cashback programs, loyalty incentives, promotional campaigns, and rewards linked to eligible activities within the Ozapay ecosystem.

The Ozapay application enables users to manage digital assets, discover nearby businesses, access exclusive offers, and participate in reward programs through a single interface.

Following a security incident involving an external token-locking service in October 2026, OZA migrated to a new Solana Token-2022 contract. The updated architecture is designed to support native token-locking mechanisms and improved token management.

OZA has a fixed maximum supply of 1 billion tokens.
